description: Implement configuration and feature flag system for maximum flexibility: feature flags, configurable scoring weights, centralized configuration management
steps: Create feature flag system in backend/app/core/features.py with support for env vars, database flags, and runtime configuration.
Make RecommendationAgentV2 scoring weights configurable via environment variables (move _ALPHA, _BETA, _GAMMA to settings).
Create ConfigurationManager class in backend/app/agents/config_manager.py for centralized agent configuration.
Add Pydantic validation schemas for agent configuration in backend/app/agents/schemas.py.
Update RecommendationAgentV2 to use ConfigurationManager instead of hardcoded values.
Add feature flags for: USE_RLHF_MODEL, ENABLE_LLM_VALIDATION, ENABLE_WEATHER_VERIFICATION, ENABLE_SFT_SCORING.
Update documentation in backend/.env.example with new configuration options.
Test configuration system: verify feature flags work, weights configurable, validation catches errors.
acceptance_criteria: Feature flags can be enabled/disabled via environment variables
Scoring weights can be changed without code modification
ConfigurationManager provides single source of truth for agent config
Invalid configuration caught at startup with clear error messages
All existing functionality works with new configuration system
verification: cd backend && python -c "from app.core.features import FeatureFlags; ff=FeatureFlags(); print('FeatureFlags OK')"
cd backend && python -c "from app.agents.config_manager import AgentConfiguration; config=AgentConfiguration(); weights=config.get_scoring_weights(); print(f'Weights: {weights}')"

cd backend && python -c "import os; os.environ['RECOMMENDATION_SFT_WEIGHT']='0.5'; from app.agents.config_manager import AgentConfiguration; config=AgentConfiguration(); assert config.get_scoring_weights().get('sft') == 0.5, 'Weight not configurable'"
cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -k config -v (create config tests if needed)
